evidence.quote: At the Effective Time, each share of Company Common Stock issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time (other than Dissenting Shares and shares cancelled pursuant to Section 1.8(c)) shall be automatically converted into the right to receive, subject to and in accordance with Section 1.9, an amount of cash equal to the Per Share Cash Amount, without interest.
"Per Share Cash Amount" means $115.00 in cash per share of Company Common Stock.

finding.rationale: All Cash. Section 1.8(a)(i) converts every share of Company Common Stock into the right to receive cash equal to the Per Share Cash Amount, defined in Section 1.1 as $115.00 in cash per share. No stock component or stockholder cash/stock election mechanism appears in the merger mechanics; Section 6.3 likewise describes shares as exchanged for cash.
